description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentService class in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manage employee attachments including retrieval, saving, and deletion, as well as access control checks.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee attachment data, including CRUD operations and access control.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization getter for EmployeeAttachmentDao instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieve a list of attachments for a specific employee and screen.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieve a specific employee attachment by employee number and attachment ID.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDetails
methods.description: Retrieve detailed information of a specific employee attachment.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Persist an EmployeeAttachment object to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Delete multiple employee attachments based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieve an employee attachment only if the user has access rights.
